name: velo-commerce
description: Headless e-commerce platform — PostgreSQL, FastAPI, Next.js

scripts.infra:reset: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.dev.yml down -v && pnpm infra:up
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:seed: cd apps/api && uv run python -m velo.scripts.seed
scripts.worker: cd apps/api && uv run arq velo.worker.WorkerSettings
scripts.search:reindex: cd apps/api && uv run python -m velo.scripts.reindex
scripts.search:check: cd apps/api && uv run python -m velo.scripts.reindex --check
scripts.storage:init: cd apps/api && uv run python -m velo.scripts.storage_init
scripts.db:reset: cd apps/api && uv run alembic downgrade base && uv run alembic upgrade head && uv run python -m velo.scripts.seed
